chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Sydney, 2023, the Women’s World Cup: England against Denmark. Six minutes in, Rachel Daly finds Lauren James on the left. James drives forward... and scores!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. James carries it inside, across the edge of the box, onto her right foot.

chapters.label: The far corner
chapters.text: From behind the goal: she strikes it past Lene Christensen, right into the far corner. England lead one-nil!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: cut inside onto your stronger foot. Look up, open your body, and curl the ball into the far corner!
